purpose: Determine whether the observed private non-financial loan stock can be mapped directly into the combined debt_service_and_credit_risk feedback node without conflating exposure scale, borrower payment burden and loan-performance state.

ecb_npl_definition.source: Bank Lending Survey annex / supervisory banking statistics
ecb_npl_definition.concept: NPL ratio is gross non-performing loans as a percentage of gross loans; credit-quality state is affected by recognition, cures, provisions/write-offs, sales and portfolio composition.
ecb_npl_definition.implication: A larger loan stock is an exposure-scale measure, not itself an NPL state or default-incidence measure.

bnr_borrower_burden.source_family: Financial Stability Report / Bank Lending Survey
bnr_borrower_burden.concept: DSTI/LSTI measures debt service relative to borrower income for specified loan portfolios.
bnr_borrower_burden.implication: Debt-service burden requires payment-flow and income information and is not identified by the outstanding loan stock alone.

retained_credit_risk_review.exact_aggregate_npl_target: ECB CBD2 quarterly Romania NPL ratio

retained_loan_stock_reference.boundary: Domestic NFCs plus households/NPISH loans from MFIs excluding the NCB, all currencies combined

structural_interpretation.loan_stock_role: Exposure scale / outstanding credit state on the frozen ECB BSI private non-financial boundary.
structural_interpretation.debt_service_role: Payment burden requiring principal and interest service relative to an aligned borrower/resource boundary.
structural_interpretation.credit_risk_role: Asset-quality/performance state requiring a frozen target such as NPL ratio or another preregistered risk concept.
structural_interpretation.combined_node_problem: The current feedback node combines debt-service burden and credit-risk state into one qualitative umbrella. These are related but not definitionally identical and may not be collapsed into a scalar without a separately frozen measurement design.
